title: Migrate gaja to fieldwork::db schema
description:
Replace gaja's inline schema (db.rs) with fieldwork::db::migrate(). Changes needed:
- Add fieldwork dependency with db-postgres and db-sqlite features
- Replace Pool enum with fieldwork::db::Pool
- Replace initialize_postgres() and initialize_sqlite() with fieldwork::db::migrate()
- Update all sqlx queries to match canonical column names/types where they differ:
  - Timestamps: TIMESTAMPTZ -> INTEGER (Unix seconds) in Postgres schema
  - gaja already uses users+personas so model is the same
  - Verify all 26 gaja tables exist in canonical schema
- Remove gaja's inline schema constants
- Run full test suite to verify nothing breaks
